subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep the shipped exit-78 supervised-lock behavior, adopt this PR's authenticated probe plus exit-0 behavior, or close this branch in favor of a narrower current-main follow-up?
rationale: The PR changes service-manager exit semantics and gateway auth probing in an area current main has already solved differently, so automation cannot choose the product and upgrade contract safely.

options.title: Keep exit 78
options.body: Treat the shipped systemd-safe exit-78 behavior as canonical and ask for any remaining probe gap as a narrow follow-up.

options.title: Adopt probe semantics
options.body: Approve the probe-based direction, but require a rebase plus real proof across shared-secret, trusted-proxy, TLS, foreign-listener, and IPv6 bind cases.

options.title: Split useful tests
options.body: Preserve only tests or docs that improve current-main behavior while dropping this branch's exit-code and auth-probe changes.

recommendation.title: Keep exit 78
recommendation.body: Treat the shipped systemd-safe exit-78 behavior as canonical and ask for any remaining probe gap as a narrow follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the shipped systemd EADDRINUSE fix that current main uses for this same gateway lock behavior.
